    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Aimable
    Equipment that can be pointed somewhere else.
    ArchiveListing
    The readable archive rows and, when recovery was needed, the warning to show with them.
    ArchiveSummary
    A day's readable count and latest capture, with any warning that qualifies them.
    BrowseArchive
    Lists saved highlights without exposing persistence or domain objects to the caller.
    Camera
    Equipment mounted on a court, recording continuously into its own buffer.
    CameraCsvFormat<C>
    The CSV fields specific to one exact camera class, after the seven shared columns.
    CameraCsvFormats
    The formats used when the caller does not provide its own registry.
    CameraKind
    Camera kinds shown by the application; a stream needs its own connection flow.
    CameraSpec
    The values entered when a camera is installed through the application.
    CameraStatus
    Operational state of a camera, and the rule that decides whether it records.
    CameraView
    The immutable camera data an interface may display: a snapshot taken when the view was built, which does not follow later changes to the camera.
    CaptureHighlight
    A press of the button: captures a court's footage, including its file when the camera writes one, and hands back the capture to archive.
    CircularBuffer
    Fixed-size memory holding the most recent seconds of footage from one camera.
    ClipAssembler
    Turns the seconds a camera kept into a playable file.
    ClipAssemblyException
    Thrown when a camera kept the seconds but the file that should hold them could not be written — the video tool failed, timed out, or the disk refused.
    ConnectStreamCamera
    Brings the phone into the gym on a court of its own, and takes it out of recording when its stream drops.
    ConsoleDemo
    Smoke-test that exercises the domain and CSV persistence without opening the window.
    CorruptedRecordException
    Thrown when one record in the archive cannot be read back into a highlight.
    Court
    A playing area of the gym, with the cameras mounted on it and the button that turns their recent footage into a highlight.
    CourtView
    The immutable court data an interface may display: a snapshot of the court and its cameras taken when the view was built.
    CsvGymRepository
    Keeps the gym's structure in a CSV file, one line per gym, court or camera.
    CsvHighlightRepository
    Keeps highlights in a CSV file, so they outlive the process that captured them.
    CsvOperatorStore
    Keeps operator accounts in a CSV file without ever writing their plain passwords.
    DomainException
    Root of every error the model raises about itself.
    DuplicateCameraException
    Thrown when a camera is installed under an id the gym already uses.
    EmptyBufferException
    Thrown when a clip is asked of a camera that has not recorded enough footage yet — typically one switched on seconds ago.
    Feed
    Where the window's seconds of footage come from: a simulated clock, or the segments the phone recorder finishes.
    FfmpegClipAssembler
    Writes a clip by joining the segment files of its seconds with FFmpeg, without re-encoding them.
    FfmpegExecutable
    Finds the FFmpeg program on this machine, which is a runtime dependency, never a build one.
    FfmpegRecorder
    The FFmpeg process that records the phone's stream into a ring of one-second segment files, for as long as the application runs.
    FixedCamera
    A camera bolted to the structure, aimed once when it is installed and never moved.
    FixedCameraCsvFormat
    The angle is the only CSV field specific to a fixed camera.
    Frame
    One second of footage, as far as this model is concerned.
    Gym
    The sports venue VarZinho is installed in: its courts, and through them every camera it owns.
    GymRepository
    Where the gym's structure lives between executions: its courts, the cameras on each and the state each camera was left in.
    GymSession
    The gym one run of the application works on, and where its changes are kept.
    Highlight
    A moment of play kept for good: what one court's camera had recorded when someone pressed the button, frozen into a clip.
    HighlightRepository
    Where highlights are kept between one request and the next.
    HighlightTitle
    The name someone gives a highlight: one readable line, never blank.
    HighlightView
    The immutable highlight data an interface may display without receiving a domain entity.
    InMemoryGymRepository
    Keeps the gym in memory only, so it vanishes with the process.
    InMemoryHighlightRepository
    Keeps highlights in memory only, so they vanish with the process.
    InMemoryOperatorStore
    Keeps operator accounts in memory only.
    Launcher
    The composition root: puts the application together — storage, the saved gym, the use cases and, when there is one, the phone — and hands the result to the window.
    LiveFeed
    The gym's clock as the window sees it: every tick is one second of footage handed to every court at once, except a court whose footage comes from somewhere else.
    Main
    Entry point of the VarZinho application.
    ManageGym
    Changes the gym's structure and exposes only immutable views of it.
    ManageRecordings
    Renames and removes completed recordings in the archive, so the window changes the archive through a use case instead of reaching the storage port itself.
    NoActiveCameraException
    Thrown when a capture is triggered on a court whose cameras are all inactive or under maintenance.
    Operator
    The staff account that operates VarZinho.
    OperatorAccess
    Creates the first account, authenticates operators and resets a forgotten password, without exposing entities.
    OperatorStore
    Where operator accounts live, independently from the gym's structure.
    OperatorView
    The immutable operator data an interface may display after sign-in.
    PendingCapture
    A completed capture awaiting archival.
    PhoneConnection
    A phone whose stream FFmpeg is already recording, with the camera that captures from it.
    PostgresGymRepository
    Keeps the gym's structure in three PostgreSQL tables — the gym, its courts with their labels, and their cameras — reached through plain JDBC.
    PostgresHighlightRepository
    Keeps highlights in a PostgreSQL table, reached through plain JDBC.
    PostgresOperatorStore
    Keeps operator accounts in PostgreSQL through plain JDBC.
    PtzCamera
    A camera that can be panned, tilted and zoomed.
    PtzCameraCsvFormat
    Rebuilds the aim through moveTo so stored values obey the camera's own rules.
    RecordingEditor
    Changes a completed recording, including the locally owned video when it exists.
    RepositoryException
    Root of the errors raised while reading or writing stored data: highlights, the gym or operator accounts.
    Resolution
    Picture size a camera records at, and that its clips are stored as.
    SampleGym
    The gym the window opens on, so a demonstration needs no typing before the first capture.
    SegmentIndex
    Which segment file holds which second, for the seconds the ring still has on disk.
    SegmentLog
    The list FFmpeg appends to each time it finishes a segment, read as it grows.
    SignedInOperator
    The operations available only after an operator has signed in.
    SignInDialog
    The gate in front of the main window: the sign-in form, or, on a run with no operator stored yet, the form that creates the first one.
    SpectatorServer
    The public spectator view: a web page that streams one court live and sells a clip of it.
    StorableHighlights
    The one rule every HighlightRepository applies before it stores anything.
    StorableOperators
    The representation rule shared by every OperatorStore.
    StoredRecordingEditor
    Renames and deletes recordings on disk, keeping the archive and the video files in step.
    StreamCamera
    A camera that is not mounted on the court but streams to it over the network — a phone on a tripod.
    VarZinhoTheme
    VarZinho's complete visual vocabulary and light/dark theme switch.
    VarZinhoWindow
    The operator's window: the courts, the capture button, the archive and the operators, kept moving by the feeds it is handed.
    VideoClip
    The record of a saved clip file: where it lives, how long it runs, what it was recorded at and how much room it takes.
